title: Improving Learning of Green's Functions Through Kernel Decomposition
summary: This work analyzes a framework for learning the solution operator, or equivalently, the Green's function, of a general self-adjoint second-order elliptic operator $\cL$. Subtracting the singular part of the Green's function, either known analytically or supplied by an explicit Laplace parametrix, recasts the learning of $\cL^{-1}$ as learning an $\cL$-harmonic extension operator on the boundary.
